title: ANet: Autoencoder-Based Local Field Potential Feature Extractor for Evaluating An Antidepressant Effect in Mice after Administering Kratom Leaf Extracts
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the antidepressant effects of Kratom leaf extracts in mice using a novel autoencoder-based method (ANet) for local field potential (LFP) analysis. While animal ethical considerations are mentioned as part of the experimental procedure, the research does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its study.
